description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with the app deployments API, including fetching project names by project ID and aggregating deployment status counts, with both server-side and client-side fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameByProjectId
methods.description: Fetches a project name given a project ID by querying the deployments API with filters.

methods.name: normalizeStatusDynamic
methods.description: Normalizes raw status values into human-readable labels, defaulting to 'Unknown' for null or undefined.

methods.name: aggregateCountsDynamic
methods.description: Aggregates deployment records into counts per status, sorted by count descending and status ascending.

methods.name: fetchStatusCountsClientSide
methods.description: Fetches deployment data in pages and aggregates counts client-side, with configurable page size and max pages.

methods.name: fetchDeploymentStatusCounts
methods.description: Main exported function that attempts to fetch deployment status counts from server, with fallback to client-side aggregation.
